name: TPK-POOL — Svc.TlmPacketizer membership pool (issue 6431)
deployment: Any deployment whose telemetry sender `tlmSend` is Svc.TlmPacketizer and whose packet set holds the three test packets of §0; venue named in the manifest and bench.json, not here

not_covered_ack: setPacketList overflow, packet-count and size-mismatch asserts: reaching them needs a different image (UT death tests cover them)
per-packet override reload, mirror-allocation failure, oversized-channel paths: unchanged by this issue, covered by the existing unit tests
TlmGet_handler: reached only where the venue wires a caller; unit test `tlmGetFirstMembershipTest` covers it
TlmRecv ignored-channel branch (channel in the omit list): needs an omit list the test deployments do not supply; unit test covers it
coverage.rationale: System threshold provisionally lowered from 75 to 50 % lines: override persistence and most rate logic are outside this plan and unit-tested. The figure is confirmed or raised at the release-lane refresh from the first measured run. UT 95 because every assert branch is forced on the host.

scope: - Venue-neutral by ruling (ledger 14): tests use only `tlmSend`, `cmdDisp` and `version` commands, events and channels. Run in both venues: fprime-zephyr-reference on bench hardware and Ref on a Linux host; one record per venue.

- Test deployment delta, uncommitted to the UUT, same packet-set change in every venue: `cmdDisp.CommandsDispatched` is removed from the packet that holds it today (`Health` id 1 in fprime-zephyr-reference, `CDH` id 1 in Ref) and listed in exactly two new packets, `TpkA` id 60 and `TpkB` id 61, both in group 1. The channel has two memberships and no other.

- Delta per venue, fprime-zephyr-reference @ 6444eb6: `tlmSend` is already `Svc.TlmPacketizer` (with `IGNORE_OMIT_LIST`); `MAX_PACKETIZER_PACKETS` 5 → 7; `MAX_PACKETIZER_CHANNELS` 40 unchanged; `MAX_PACKETIZER_MEMBERSHIPS` new = 26 (25 entries today − 1 + 2), confirmed from the build's sizing check.

- Delta per venue, Ref: `tlmSend` switched from `Svc.TlmChan` to `Svc.TlmPacketizer` with a `setPacketList` call; 37 packets and 172 memberships (171 − 1 + 2), under the defaults 50 and 200; counts confirmed from the build's sizing check.
- Out of scope: the build-time sizing check (pytest in `cmake/test`, not a system test); rate logic and override persistence (unchanged).
entry_gates: - L0 desk check: the longest window (L2-1) holds 2 markers + 4 commands = 6 commands, about 14 event rows and 2 channel samples; no downlink budget is approached in either venue. Bench confirmation pending at dry run.
- Group 1 of section REALTIME sends on change in the image (default `ON_CHANGE_MIN`); confirmed at dry run by L0-2, else the plan returns to design.
- Telemetry tick: `cmdDisp` writes `CommandsDispatched` from its rate-group handler, 1 s in both venues (helper argument `tick_s`); confirmed against each topology at dry run.
- Stage-1 close: `fprime-util check` on `Svc/TlmPacketizer` passes with every unit-test row of the SDD implemented.
- Marker round-trip: `CMD_NO_OP_STRING("<n>")` returns `NoOpStringReceived` with text `Received a NO-OP string=<n>` byte-exact through the archive.
- Image built from the manifest SHAs; dictionary from that build.
levels: L0 provenance/feasibility · L2 functional · L6 negative controls · L7 final state. L3 (reset), L4 (endurance) and L5 (fault paths) have no test: the change has no persistent state, no timing requirement, and its only fault path is a boot assert that needs a different image.

TPK-013.note: The limit and its assert can only be reached with an image whose packet list overflows the pool, which is a different build; unit tests `membershipCapacityExactTest` and `membershipOverflowTest` verify it. No system test is traced to it.

tests.title: Image identity
tests.purpose: Shows the running image is the one built from the manifest's commits.
tests.evidence: Version events equal to the manifest's describe strings.

tests.title: Packets flow on change
tests.purpose: Shows the image boots with the two-packet channel and sends it on change.

all_of.text: cmdDisp.CommandsDispatched has >= 1 sample in the window

tests.evidence: A CommandsDispatched sample inside the window; no NoChan event.

tests.title: Channel value reaches its first packet
tests.purpose: Shows channel updates are stored in, and downlinked by, the first packet listing the channel.

all_of.text: cmdDisp.CommandsDispatched tracks cmdDisp.OpCodeDispatched: >= 2 increasing samples, each step == dispatches between them

rationale.pred: cmdDisp.CommandsDispatched tracks cmdDisp.OpCodeDispatched: >= 2 increasing samples, each step == dispatches between them
rationale.text: the channel is listed only in packets 60 and 61; packet 61 is set SEND_NEVER two ticks before the start marker and released two ticks after the end marker, so every sample inside the window is downlinked by packet 60. The end marker is itself a dispatched command, so the held packet's pending sample carries a time after the window and its flush on release is excluded. A membership that is not written leaves packet 60 unchanged, it is not sent, and the check fails on sample count

tests.evidence: At least two rising CommandsDispatched samples, each step equal to the OpCodeDispatched rows archived between them.

tests.title: Channel value reaches its second packet
tests.purpose: Shows the same channel's updates are also stored in the second packet listing it.

all_of.text: cmdDisp.CommandsDispatched tracks cmdDisp.OpCodeDispatched: >= 2 increasing samples, each step == dispatches between them

rationale.pred: cmdDisp.CommandsDispatched tracks cmdDisp.OpCodeDispatched: >= 2 increasing samples, each step == dispatches between them
rationale.text: the channel is listed only in packets 60 and 61; packet 60 is set SEND_NEVER two ticks before the start marker and released two ticks after the end marker, so every sample inside the window is downlinked by packet 61. The end marker is itself a dispatched command, so the held packet's pending sample carries a time after the window and its flush on release is excluded. A membership that is not written leaves packet 61 unchanged, it is not sent, and the check fails on sample count

tests.evidence: At least two rising CommandsDispatched samples, each step equal to the OpCodeDispatched rows archived between them.

tests.title: Unknown packet is refused
tests.purpose: Shows a send request for an unknown packet is refused and reported.

rationale.text: SEND_PKT for an unknown id answers VALIDATION_ERROR, so this test does not use STD (which requires zero OpCodeError) and expects exactly one

tests.evidence: PacketNotFound(999) once, one OpCodeError, no PacketSent.

tests.title: Final state
tests.purpose: Leaves both test packets enabled; the channel's value still follows the archive's dispatch count.

all_of.text: cmdDisp.CommandsDispatched tracks cmdDisp.OpCodeDispatched: >= 2 increasing samples, each step == dispatches between them

tests.evidence: Rising CommandsDispatched samples that match the OpCodeDispatched rows the ground archive holds (a path independent of the packetizer's storage).

final_state.rationale: The component has no stored state to dump; the check recomputes each CommandsDispatched step from the archived OpCodeDispatched events, a path that does not pass through the packetizer's channel storage.

not_covered: - TPK-013 (limit and assert), and every other setPacketList assert: needs a different image; unit tests.
- Memory saved by the pool: not observable through commands or telemetry; shown by the SDD sizing table and the build's map file (inspection).
- The build-time sizing check: verified by pytest in `cmake/test` and a compile-failure fixture, not on a bench.
- TPK-002, 004..012: unchanged behavior, existing unit tests; no system test added by this issue.
- State after a drawn `final_packets_held` fault: the test packets stay held back until reboot; the bench is power-cycled or reflashed after every run for record.
decision_log: 1. 2026-11-23 approver — venues: fprime-zephyr-reference on bench hardware and Ref on a Linux host (ledger 12).
2. 2026-11-23 approver — the tests run in both venues; the venue is a run artifact and stays out of the SDD (ledger 14).
3. 2026-11-23 designer — marker = `cmdDisp.CMD_NO_OP_STRING`; no tester component is added.
4. 2026-11-23 designer — test-deployment delta of the scope section (two test packets, the channel moved into them, sizing constants per venue); for the approver at gate 1.
5. 2026-11-23 designer — system coverage threshold provisionally 50 % lines; for gate 1.

6. 2026-11-24 designer, review round 1 — packets are sent by the rate logic, not SEND_PKT (SEND_PKT bypasses enable checks and logs PacketSent on acceptance); menu max_count 2 over four faulted tests; TPK-013 is UT only with no system test traced.
7. 2026-11-24 designer, review round 2 — the hold-back and its release sit outside the L2 windows, two ticks clear of the markers.
